planning_horizon_days: <int> Number of days in the monthly scheduling period.
num_crew_members: <int> Total number of cabin crew members to be scheduled.
num_mother_pairings: <int> Total number of distinct pairings that need to be covered.
num_daughter_pairings: <int> Total number of pairing copies to be covered, summing the coverage requirement across all pairings.
num_aircraft_types: <int> Number of distinct aircraft types operated during the planning horizon.

work_rules.weekly_rest_period_hours: <int> Minimum consecutive hours of rest each crew member must receive within every calendar week.
work_rules.monthly_rest_additional_hours: <int> Additional consecutive hours of rest that must be appended to one weekly rest period each month.
work_rules.max_spread_between_breaks_days: <int> Maximum number of days allowed between two consecutive periodic rest breaks.
work_rules.monthly_flight_limit_hours: <int> Maximum total flight hours a crew member may accumulate during the planning month.
work_rules.rolling_flight_limit_hours: <int> Maximum total flight hours a crew member may accumulate in the rolling period spanning the last 15 days of the preceding month and the first 15 days of the current month.
work_rules.rolling_flight_period_description: <str> Description of the date range used for the rolling flight-hour limit.
work_rules.max_consecutive_early_departures_before_: <int> Maximum number of consecutive days on which a crew member may depart before 8:00 AM.
work_rules.max_cross_pairings_per_month: <int> Maximum number of cross-base pairings a crew member may fly in one month.
work_rules.week_definition: <str> Definition of the calendar week boundaries used for weekly rest calculations.
work_rules.weekly_rest_latest_start_on_sunday_hour: <int> Latest hour on Sunday by which a weekly rest period must begin.

objective.description: <str> Plain-language statement of what the objective function measures.

pairings.start_day: <int> Zero-based day within the planning horizon on which this pairing departs.
pairings.duration_days: <int> Number of consecutive calendar days this pairing spans.
pairings.departure_hour: <float> Hour of day (fractional, 24-hour clock) at which the crew departs on the start day.
pairings.return_hour: <float> Hour of day (fractional, 24-hour clock) at which the crew returns on the final day of the pairing.
pairings.flight_hours: <float> Total hours of actual flying time contained in this pairing.
pairings.duration_minutes: <int> Total elapsed time of this pairing from departure to return, in minutes.
pairings.aircraft_type: <int> Aircraft type required for this pairing, as a zero-based index into the set of aircraft types.
pairings.is_cross_pairing: <bool> Whether this pairing departs from one crew base and arrives at a different base.
pairings.coverage_requirement: <int> Number of crew members that must be assigned to fly this pairing.

crew_members.id: <int> Unique identifier for this crew member.
crew_members.qualifications: <list[int]> Aircraft types this crew member is certified to operate, as zero-based indices.
crew_members.pre_assigned_days: <list[int]> Zero-based days within the planning horizon that are already blocked by pre-assigned activities.

pre_assigned_activities.start_day: <int> Zero-based first day of this pre-assigned activity.
pre_assigned_activities.end_day: <int> Zero-based last day (inclusive) of this pre-assigned activity.
pre_assigned_activities.duration_days: <int> Number of consecutive days this pre-assigned activity spans.
pre_assigned_activities.type: <str> Category of the pre-assigned activity (e.g., annual_leave, training, medical, reserve_block, transition, desiderata).

crew_members.flight_hours_previous_15_days: <float> Total flight hours this crew member accumulated during the last 15 days of the preceding month.
